# STELLAR (08 · stellar)

A planetarium of 1,900 particles that morph between a word, Orion, a galaxy and the dome.

- **Technique:** PARTICLE MORPH
- **Tags:** space, science, particles, dark, education, cosmic, museum
- **Best for:** museums & planetariums; science & education; events
- **Fonts:** Unbounded, Manrope
- **Fonts href:** `https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Unbounded:wght@300;500;700&family=Manrope:wght@300;400;500&display=swap`
- **Swatch:** #070514 · #b3a8f7 · #ffd98a
- **Dependencies:** none beyond the shared helpers
- **Source:** `src/templates/stellar/` (Template.astro, content.ts, cosmos.ts, meta.ts, skies.ts, style.css, theme.css)

## Signature effects
- `cosmos.ts`
  - `initCosmos(canvas: HTMLCanvasElement, label: HTMLElement | null)` — Particle morph: N particles spring toward target point clouds that cycle between a word, Orion, a galaxy and a dome, and scatter away from the pointer. Reads `data-word` (string) and `data-shape-names` (JSON `[orion, galaxy, dome]`) from the canvas; the current shape's name is written into `label`.
- `skies.ts`
  - `initSkyIcons(els: Iterable<HTMLElement>)` — Draw the mini sky illustration named by each element's `data-obj` (venus, orion, andromeda, iss) as inline SVG over a shared random field of dust.

## Content model — `content.ts`
Every user-visible string lives here. Fields ending in `Html` are trusted inline HTML (`<em> <b> <i> <br> <a> <span>`).

```ts
/** Fields ending in `Html` are trusted, author-written HTML (inline <em>/<b>/<a>/<br> only). */
export interface Link {
  label: string;
  href: string;
}

/** Which mini sky illustration a forecast card draws. */
export type SkyObject = 'venus' | 'orion' | 'andromeda' | 'iss';

export interface Content {
  seo: { title: string; description: string; ogTitle?: string; ogDescription?: string };
  /** Spaced display wordmark in nav + footer; the `<span>` letter is accented. */
  wordmarkHtml: string;
  /** Top-bar links; each href targets a section id. */
  nav: Link[];
  hero: {
    /** Accessible name of the particle canvas. */
    canvasLabel: string;
    kicker: string;
    /** `<b>` renders brighter. */
    bodyHtml: string;
    cta: Link;
    morph: {
      /** Small caption above the current shape name. */
      label: string;
      /** The word the particles spell on load and between shapes. Also the first shape name. */
      word: string;
      /** Names shown while the particles form the constellation, galaxy and dome, in that order. */
      shapeNames: [orion: string, galaxy: string, dome: string];
    };
  };
  shows: {
    id: string;
    kicker: string;
    /** `<em>` renders lavender. */
    headingHtml: string;
    items: {
      /** Start time, e.g. "18:00". */
      time: string;
      /** Running time under the start time, e.g. "45 MIN". */
      duration: string;
      title: string;
      description: string;
      /** Age pill (hidden on mobile). */
      age: string;
      book: Link;
    }[];
  };
  tonight: {
    id: string;
    kicker: string;
    /** `<em>` renders lavender. */
    headingHtml: string;
    objects: {
      kind: SkyObject;
      /** Magnitude badge, e.g. "MAG −4.2". */
      magnitude: string;
      name: string;
      /** Category and sky position, e.g. "Planet · West". */
      type: string;
      description: string;
    }[];
  };
  membership: {
    id: string;
    kicker: string;
    /** `<em>` renders lavender. */
    headingHtml: string;
    /** `<em>` renders gold. */
    offerHtml: string;
    description: string;
    cta: Link;
  };
  footer: {
    /** Address / hours; `<br>` allowed. */
    noteHtml: string;
    /** Credit line above the showcase link (`<a>` allowed). */
    creditHtml?: string;
  };
}
```

- Style kit for an existing project: `node <skill-dir>/scripts/weft.mjs style stellar --out <dir>`
